summary: PartialOrd<Bytes> for [u8] delegates to other.partial_cmp(self), reversing unequal operands and exchanging Less with Greater. The fix compares byte slices with self first, preserving lexicographic order. The proposed reversal isolates this implementation change. Blocked: the fix adds no tests, and inspection of existing tests and source found no upstream test detecting the reversed ordering at this revision; existing cross-type equality tests do not exercise PartialOrd.
